answer: Make every new agent lock a jade-grade bond that only unlocks drop by drop, like nectar from a slow tap, as independent peers verify its completed jobs. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand names, but each bond is real money frozen for weeks, and the release schedule means a fresh identity earns almost nothing before it has proven itself. Any agent caught cheating has its remaining bond burned and its record stained umber in the shared ledger, so the same operator cannot return under a new label. Honest agents barely notice the wait; attackers pay full price for every fake.
